title: ThreePart normal/S1 current static selector and conditional segment durations
facts: AbilityStandard.Awake uses Component.GetComponents<Behaviour> on the same GameObject, initializes each behaviour; ThreePart subclass is present on exact selected ability GameObjects
ThreePart.Init initializes default bundle; _GetAnimBundle selects default/down bundle
InitAnimation counts begin only if firstAttack gate allows; uses sum(begin+oneshot+end)/cooldown reciprocal after explicit min/max duration-scale clamps
MoveNext plays begin if m_hasBeginAnim, then oneshot, then configured end if m_hasEndAnim; each segment yields WaitForFixedSeconds after Unit.PlayAnimation
Spine.UpdateAnimationData copies actual Spine.Animation duration to AnimationData.time; GetAnimationTime divides time by source speed
Silverash SelectMethod 0 is Random, _GetAbilityInternal reaches random branch; three _abilities PPtrs are actual candidate children; no probability or order assigned
limitations: current XLua/hotfix, actual mode/skin/direction and firstAttack gate unknown
segment durations omit scheduler resume phase, interruption, projectile travel and callback phase
Ability end animation is independent of empty ThreePart.end; no actual skill end inferred
body event frames are not a whole-chain first attack; generic windup is suppressed unless explicitly overridden
conditional profiles use raw seconds and numerical formula references, never ceiling/normalized callback frames
